title: Quarter Volume Library Prep Step 4: Adapter Ligation
author: Opentrons
materials: The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.
The OT-2 will pause for incubation steps in an off-deck thermocycler.
Proceed with incubation on off-deck thermocycler, then either part-5 or part-6.

steps.title: Configure pipettes and labware
steps.instruction: Use multi‑channel P20 and P300 pipettes for adapter ligation on 48–96 input samples; select labware for the library‑prep plate, reagent plate, and reagent‑tube rack on the temperature module as desired.

steps.title: Pre‑cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Set the Temperature Module to 4 °C in the OT app before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Verify reagents on deck
steps.instruction: Confirm that all required reagents are loaded on the deck with sufficient volume; the protocol will prompt you to check.

steps.title: Pre‑mix and dispense ligation mix
steps.instruction: Using the P300 multi‑channel with a single tip on the rear‑most channel, pre‑mix the ligation mix, add the ligation mix to the mix tube, add the enhancer to the same tube, mix, then dispense the resulting mixture into the second column of the reagent plate.

substeps.instruction: Pre‑mix ligation mix with P300 tip
Add ligation mix to mix tube
Dispense mixture into second column of reagent plate

steps.title: Dispense adapters
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel, deliver the adapter solution into each well of the library‑prep plate.

steps.title: Transfer ligation mixture
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel, aspirate the mixture from the second column of the reagent plate and dispense it into the wells of the library‑prep plate, then mix each well.

steps.title: Pause for off‑deck incubation
steps.instruction: Program the OT‑2 to pause while the plate is moved to an off‑deck thermocycler for incubation.

steps.title: Add user dilution
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel, dispense the user‑specified dilution into each well of the library‑prep plate and mix.

steps.title: Incubate on thermocycler
steps.instruction: Place the plate in the off‑deck thermocycler and run the required incubation; after completion proceed to part‑5 (size selection) or part‑6 (clean‑up).
